question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.
sql:
WITH 
-- Region analysis
region_before AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(sales) as avg_before FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 
    GROUP BY region
),
region_after AS (
    SELECT region, AVG(sales) as avg_after FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 
    GROUP BY region
),
region_pct AS (
    SELECT b.region, (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / NULLIF(b.avg_before, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM region_before b
    JOIN region_after a ON b.region = a.region
),
-- Platform analysis
platform_before AS (
    SELECT platform, AVG(sales) as avg_before FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 
    GROUP BY platform
),
platform_after AS (
    SELECT platform, AVG(sales) as avg_after FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 
    GROUP BY platform
),
platform_pct AS (
    SELECT b.platform, (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / NULLIF(b.avg_before, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM platform_before b
    JOIN platform_after a ON b.platform = a.platform
),
-- age_band analysis
age_band_before AS (
    SELECT age_band, AVG(sales) as avg_before FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 
    GROUP BY age_band
),
age_band_after AS (
    SELECT age_band, AVG(sales) as avg_after FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 
    GROUP BY age_band
),
age_band_pct AS (
    SELECT b.age_band, (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / NULLIF(b.avg_before, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM age_band_before b
    JOIN age_band_after a ON b.age_band = a.age_band
),
-- demographic analysis
demographic_before AS (
    SELECT demographic, AVG(sales) as avg_before FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 
    GROUP BY demographic
),
demographic_after AS (
    SELECT demographic, AVG(sales) as avg_after FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 
    GROUP BY demographic
),
demographic_pct AS (
    SELECT b.demographic, (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / NULLIF(b.avg_before, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM demographic_before b
    JOIN demographic_after a ON b.demographic = a.demographic
),
-- customer_type analysis
customer_type_before AS (
    SELECT customer_type, AVG(sales) as avg_before FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
customer_type_after AS (
    SELECT customer_type, AVG(sales) as avg_after FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
customer_type_pct AS (
    SELECT b.customer_type, (a.avg_after - b.avg_before) / NULLIF(b.avg_before, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM customer_type_before b
    JOIN customer_type_after a ON b.customer_type = a.customer_type
)
SELECT 'region' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change FROM region_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'platform' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change FROM platform_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'age_band' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change FROM age_band_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'demographic' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change FROM demographic_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'customer_type' as attr_type, ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change FROM customer_type_pct
ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
